text:
ana_csm: Heads-up — Sparrow (enterprise) just flagged a multi-team push. New data team + product analytics want tabular->embedding indexing for search/QA. Likely QPS 3x current in 6 weeks.

suhail_success_engineer: Nice, do we have concrete numbers or a list of endpoints they expect to hit? any existing pilot?

ana_csm: They ran a small pilot last month (100k rows). Next phase is org-wide: ~1M rows/day ingest, read-heavy queries, peak windows during business hours ~1200 r/s. Renewal review in 9w — customer is excited but watching latency/cost.

eli_eng: pinging infra — 1200 r/s read-heavy should be fine on Dedicated but needs caching + prefix KV tuning. Do they need streaming responses?

ana_csm: No streaming. They care about 95th latency <= 150ms and per-request cost. Also want embeddings for tabular columns + full-text.

eli_eng: Ok. Suggest try Dedicated pilot with autoscale floor, enable prefix caching and LRU KV for top queries. Will need model recommendation (quantized embed model) + batching policy.

deploy-bot: [alert] quota_check: Sparrow-prod tokens expected to exceed free tier on 2026-05-12 if ramp continues.

ana_csm: @devex-liz can we prep an enablement playbook + runbook for their SREs (ingest, monitoring, rollback)? Also need product usage checklist for renewal meeting.

devex-liz: Yep — I can do a 60m workshop + a one-pager. Will include dashboards to watch (token burn, p50/p95 latency, failed batches). Can we get sample traffic and common query patterns?

ana_csm: I'll ask Sparrow for a 24h sample and top-100 query list. Also capturing feedback: they mentioned slow cold-cache searches and occasional rank drift on date fields.

suhail_success_engineer: We'll add a prompt set to the evaluations team to track quality regressions during quantization. Also recommend a canary rollout for embed model changes.

eli_eng: Quick config draft I propose:
```
- Dedicated pool: 4x A100 equiv
- Autoscale min: 2 nodes, max: 8 nodes
- Batching: dynamic 50ms window, max batch 128
- KV cache: 8GB LRU per node
- Model: rwd-embed-small-quant (recommended)
```

ana_csm: That looks good. Can you estimate cost delta vs current hosted? Sparrow wants ballpark for renewal deck.

eli_eng: Rough calc: +35% infra cost vs current hosted at target QPS, but per-query latency drops ~40%. I'll have a more precise cost model by EOD tomorrow.

devex-liz: Scheduling workshop Thurs 11am PT — invite Sparrow SREs/product. I'll draft the enablement checklist and send a calendar invite.

ana_csm: Action items: 1) I get 24h sample + top-100 queries (by Tue). 2) Eli to produce cost model + final config (EOD). 3) Suhail to add eval prompt set and canary plan (Wed). 4) Liz to run workshop (Thurs 11am). 5) I'll prepare renewal slide with risks/mitigations.

suhail_success_engineer: Noted. Also flagging potential renewal risk — if we can't meet p95 SLA or show cost/control story, they may scope down a month pre-renewal. Keep exec loop informed.

ana_csm: Agreed — I'll loop AM to the renewal owner and AE. 

eli_eng: One more note: if they insist on on-prem/private for compliance, we'd need lead time ~6 weeks for Private package. Call that out in the deck.

ana_csm: Good catch. Ok team — I'll post updates in this thread as we get samples and numbers. :thumbsup:
